 Follow Sylvester Stallone Reveals What Finally Ended His Decades-Long Feud With Arnold Schwarzenegger
 Priya Walia Thu, November 5, 2026 at 1:06 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Sylvester Stallone Reveals What Finally Ended His Decades-Long Feud With Arnold Schwarzenegger Sylvester Stallone has revealed what finally brought his decades-long rivalry with Arnold Schwarzenegger to an end, explaining how a major career decision helped the two Hollywood action stars stop competing against each other.
 During his November 5 appearance on The Rest Is Entertainment podcast, Stallone reflected on the intense competition between the pair, which lasted approximately 20 years.
 Stallone recalled how hostile their relationship had become during their years as competing action stars.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "We couldn't get on the same stage together to make a presentation or a speech," Stallone said.
 The actor explained that their rivalry finally began to fade when Schwarzenegger decided to pursue politics rather than continue competing for Hollywood roles.
 In 2003, Schwarzenegger entered the race for California governor, eventually winning the election and serving in the position until 2011.
 Reflecting on the change, Stallone said, "I said, enough of this. We're not in competition."
 He also acknowledged that the rivalry had pushed him to work harder throughout his career.
 "All right. Thank you very much for waking me up, lighting a fire under me. And he felt the same way," Stallone recalled, as reported by Entertainment Weekly .
 Advertisement Advertisement The full conversation is featured in the November 5 episode of The Rest Is Entertainment , available on Apple Podcasts. Hosted by Marina Hyde and Richard Osman, the episode sees Stallone discuss his Hollywood career, his rivalry with Schwarzenegger and some of his biggest professional regrets.
 The former rivals eventually reunited onscreen in 2010's The Expendables , in which Schwarzenegger made a cameo appearance. They subsequently appeared together in The Expendables 2 (2012), Escape Plan (2013) and The Expendables 3 (2014).
 Interestingly, what began as one of Hollywood's most intense celebrity rivalries eventually developed into mutual respect and friendship. 
 Stallone's latest comments offer a closer look at the unexpected turning point that helped put their long-running feud behind them.
